source.subject: compiler: M1 front end (parse, check, JSONL diagnostics)

prompt:
`bmb check` does not report the diagnostic E0502 yet: vacuous predicate used in a contract. It came with the commit "compiler: M1 front end (parse, check, JSONL diagnostics)". Implement it. Examples of what `bmb check` must print (one JSON line per diagnostic; the path in `file` is the one given on the command line), each after the source line it points at:

    requires always(),
    {"code": "E0502", "severity": "error", "message": "`specs::always` is the constant `true`; it states nothing", "file": "err/specs.bmb", "line": 29, "col": 18, "end_line": 29, "end_col": 26}

Everything else the program prints must stay as it is.
